risk_summary: The excerpt provides meaningful quantitative disclosure on revenue, margins, acquisitions, customer concentration, and COVID-19 impacts, but relies on standard forward-looking disclaimers and several unquantified contingencies. Risk is elevated due to pandemic-driven procedure volatility, delayed clinical programs, margin compression, inventory impairment, and dependence on Mitek and a small customer group. The tone is cautiously negative, despite management’s optimistic positioning around acquisitions and market expansion.
